 Mr. Nikhil Patil i/b Mr. Prabhakar M. Jadhav, for the Applicant.
 Mr. Y. M. Nakhwa, A.P.P for the Respondent No.1- State.
 Mr. Sudip Mallick, for the Respondent No.2.
 Coram : Revati Mohite Dere &
 Prithviraj K. Chavan, Jj.
 Date : 17th January 2023
 P.C. :
1.
This is an application seeking quashing of the proceeding with the consent of the parties.

It appears that the petitioner had settled their dispute i.e. the case under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, with the consent of the respondent No.2 for a sum of Rs.10 lakhs, by way of full and final settlement.
We found the said amount inadequate and insufficient and as such asked the learned counsel for the applicant to enhance the said amount.

Pursuant 910-aplst.637.2023.doc thereto, the learned counsel for the applicant on telephonic instructions of the applicant makes a statement that the applicant is ready to pay an additional sum of Rs.10 lakhs to the respondent No.2 for the welfare of the children.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant seeks time to make the said payment.
